picture.title: 坚持与奋斗（2018 真题主题）
picture.prompt: 图画：一位学生面对一座大山，山脚下写着「困难」二字，学生选择一步步攀登。
picture.essay:
As is symbolically depicted in the picture, a student stands at the foot of a huge mountain labeled with the word "difficulty". Instead of being frightened, he chooses to climb it step by step, with sweat on his forehead and determination in his eyes.

The picture is intended to convey the message that persistence is the key to overcoming difficulties. Undoubtedly, the cartoonist aims to remind us that no success can be achieved without sustained effort. Take the case of many famous scientists as an example. They made countless failed attempts before their final breakthroughs. This phenomenon can be attributed to the fact that challenges are inevitable in our lives, and only those who never give up can eventually reach the summit.

In conclusion, it is high time that we adopted a positive attitude toward difficulties. From my perspective, we should regard every obstacle as a chance to grow, and keep moving forward with perseverance. Only in this way can we embrace a brighter future.
picture.translation:
如图所示，一名学生站在一座标注着「困难」的大山脚下。他没有畏惧，而是选择一步一步向上攀登，额头满是汗水，眼中充满坚定。

这幅图意在传达这样的信息：坚持是克服困难的关键。毫无疑问，漫画家想提醒我们，没有持续的努力就无法取得成功。以许多著名科学家为例，他们在最终突破之前经历了无数次失败的尝试。这一现象可以归因于这样一个事实：挑战在生活中不可避免，只有永不放弃的人才能最终登上顶峰。

总之，是时候以积极的态度面对困难了。在我看来，我们应该把每一个障碍视为成长的机会，并以坚持不懈的精神不断前进。只有这样，我们才能拥抱更加光明的未来。
picture.comment: 结构清晰：描述图画→阐释寓意→举例论证→总结建议。使用了 as is symbolically depicted、It is high time that（虚拟语气）、Only in this way can（倒装）等高分句型。

picture.title: 2019 年英语一大作文真题范文：坚持不懈
picture.prompt: 图画：两个学生结伴登山，其中一个累得满头大汗想要放弃，另一个伸手鼓励他继续前进。图下文字：在通往山顶的路上。
picture.essay:
As is vividly depicted in the picture, two students are climbing a mountain together. One of them, sweating heavily and looking exhausted, intends to give up halfway, while the other stretches out his hand to encourage him to keep moving forward. Below the drawing is a caption reading "On the way to the summit".

What the cartoonist intends to convey is that perseverance is indispensable on the road to success. The journey toward any goal, just like climbing a mountain, is bound to be full of hardships and setbacks. Only those who persist can finally enjoy the scenery at the top. This truth can be illustrated by numerous examples: athletes endure years of lonely training before standing on the podium, and researchers may fail hundreds of times before a single breakthrough. In the face of difficulty, giving up means losing everything, whereas persistence promises hope.

To sum up, we should never be discouraged by temporary failure. As the saying goes, "Where there is a will, there is a way." If we encourage each other and keep climbing step by step, the summit of success is never far away.
picture.translation:
如图所示，两个学生正在一起爬山。其中一人大汗淋漓、疲惫不堪，想要在半路放弃，另一个人则伸出手鼓励他继续前进。图画下方写着：在通往山顶的路上。

作者想传达的是，坚持是通往成功不可或缺的品质。通往任何目标的旅程，就像爬山一样，注定充满艰辛与挫折。只有坚持到底的人，才能最终欣赏到山顶的风景。这一道理可以用无数事例来说明：运动员在登上领奖台之前要经历多年孤独的训练，研究人员可能在取得一次突破之前失败数百次。面对困难，放弃意味着失去一切，而坚持则预示着希望。

总之，我们绝不应被暂时的失败所打击。正如谚语所说：“有志者，事竟成。”如果我们互相鼓励、一步一步向上攀登，成功的山顶就并不遥远。
picture.comment: 首段准确描述图画并点出“鼓励与坚持”的互动；第二段用比喻+举例论证“坚持”的价值；末段引用谚语收束。结构完整、主题明确，图画作文三段式标准示范。

picture.title: 2020 年英语一大作文真题范文：好习惯成就未来
picture.prompt: 两幅对比图画：左图中一个女孩提前完成了作业，正安心地读书，书桌上写着「早点完成，心里踏实」；右图中一个男孩把作业拖到深夜才仓促动笔，写着「不到最后一刻，绝不动笔」。
picture.essay:
The two pictures above present a striking contrast. On the left, a girl finishes her homework ahead of schedule and then reads at ease, with a note saying "Finish it early and feel at ease". On the right, a boy leaves his assignment until late at night and starts to write in a hurry, with a note reading "Never start until the last minute".

Obviously, the cartoonist aims to highlight the decisive role that good habits play in our lives. Developing the habit of planning ahead and acting promptly not only improves efficiency but also keeps our minds calm and confident. In contrast, procrastination, as shown by the boy, often leads to anxiety, poor quality of work, and a constant sense of being chased by deadlines. The gap between the two students does not lie in intelligence but in the power of daily routines and self-discipline.

In my view, it is high time that we cultivated good habits such as making schedules and finishing tasks on time. As the proverb goes, "Habit is a second nature." If we can act on today's plan today, tomorrow will surely reward us with ease and achievement.
picture.translation:
上面的两幅图形成了鲜明的对比。左边，一个女孩提前完成了作业，然后悠闲地读书，上面写着“早点完成，心里踏实”。右边，一个男孩把作业留到深夜才仓促动笔，上面写着“不到最后一刻，绝不动笔”。

显然，作者旨在强调好习惯在我们生活中起到的决定性作用。养成提前规划、及时行动的习惯，不仅能提高效率，还能让内心保持平静与自信。相反，正如图中的男孩所示，拖延往往带来焦虑、低质量的工作以及不断被截止日期追赶的紧迫感。两个学生之间的差距并不在于智力，而在于日常习惯和自律的力量。

在我看来，现在是我们养成制定计划、按时完成任务等好习惯的时候了。正如谚语所说：“习惯成自然。”如果我们今天能完成今天的计划，明天必将以轻松和成就回报我们。
picture.comment: 首段用对比结构描述两幅图（contrast 结构是此类题目的标准打法）；第二段正反论证好习惯与拖延的差异；末段提出建议并引用谚语。语言亮点：ahead of schedule / procrastination / a second nature。

picture.title: 2021 年英语一大作文真题范文：坚持自己的梦想
picture.prompt: 图画：一个小男孩打扮成孙悟空，手持金箍棒，对父亲说：“同学们都觉得学戏曲没意思。”父亲回答：“只要你自己喜欢，那就足够了。”
picture.essay:
As is vividly depicted in the cartoon, a little boy dressed up as the Monkey King, holding a small stick, is talking to his father. The boy says that many of his classmates find learning traditional opera boring, while the father replies that as long as the boy himself enjoys it, that is enough.

What the drawing conveys to us is that we should stick to our dreams no matter how difficult the path may be. Dreams serve as the compass of life, guiding us through darkness and confusion. However, many people abandon their ideals halfway because of setbacks, criticism, or the temptation of comfort. History and daily life both tell us that those who persist in pursuing their dreams, from scientists who once worked in obscurity to entrepreneurs who failed many times, are the ones who eventually change the world and themselves.

In conclusion, pursuing a dream is a long-distance race rather than a sprint. We ought to remain confident, patient and courageous, because every step forward, however small, brings us closer to the light we have been longing for.
picture.translation:
如图所示，一个年轻人正坚定地朝自己的目标奔跑，尽管路上布满障碍。背景写满了代表梦想与抱负的词语，暗示通往梦想的道路从不平坦。

这幅图告诉我们：无论道路多么艰难，我们都应坚持自己的梦想。梦想是人生的罗盘，指引我们穿越黑暗与迷茫。然而，很多人因为挫折、批评或安逸的诱惑而半途放弃理想。历史与日常生活都告诉我们，那些坚持追求梦想的人——从默默无闻的科学家到屡败屡战的创业者——正是最终改变世界也改变自己的人。

总之，追逐梦想是一场长跑而不是冲刺。我们应该保持自信、耐心与勇气，因为每向前一步，无论多小，都让我们离渴望的光芒更近一步。
picture.comment: 首段点题式描述图画，第二段用“梦想是罗盘”比喻并列举典型人群，末段以 long-distance race 的比喻收束。比喻链完整，适合考场快速成文。

picture.title: 2022 年英语一大作文真题范文：打破专业限制，全面发展
picture.prompt: 图画：两个穿校服的女生站在贴有校园讲座海报的公告栏前。短发女生说：“又不是我们专业的，听了也没用。”长发女生说：“去听听总会有好处的。”
picture.essay:
As is vividly illustrated in the picture, a young man is writing a knowledge structure on the blackboard that links different disciplines together, breaking through the boundaries of a single major. The caption reminds us that comprehensive development requires us to go beyond the limits of our own specialty.

The picture intends to tell us that in today's rapidly changing world, relying solely on one narrow field of expertise is no longer enough. Science and society are becoming increasingly integrated: a programmer needs to understand user psychology, a doctor needs to communicate with compassion, and an engineer must consider economic and environmental factors. Broadening our horizons not only enriches our minds but also enables us to solve complex problems with creative combinations of knowledge. As the saying goes, "Jack of all trades" — yet the modern world truly favors those who are masters in one field while remaining open to many.

In a word, we should treat lifelong learning and interdisciplinary thinking as necessities rather than options. By stepping out of our comfort zone and embracing new fields, we can become more capable, more adaptable, and better prepared for the future.
picture.translation:
如图所示，一个年轻人正在黑板上写下将不同学科联系起来的跨学科知识结构，打破了单一专业的界限。文字提示我们：全面发展要求我们超越自身专业的限制。

这幅图想告诉我们：在当今快速变化的世界里，仅靠单一狭窄领域的专长已远远不够。科学与社会日益融合：程序员需要理解用户心理，医生需要富有同理心地沟通，工程师必须考虑经济与环境因素。拓宽视野不仅能丰富头脑，还能让我们用创造性的知识组合解决复杂问题。

总之，我们应该把终身学习和跨学科思维当作必需而非选项。走出舒适区、拥抱新领域，我们就能变得更加能干、更具适应性，为未来做好更充分的准备。
picture.comment: 首段描述“跨学科”核心意象，第二段用三个职业实例论证知识融合的必要性，末段落到终身学习。例证具体、逻辑递进，符合“全面发展”类话题的写作套路。

picture.title: 2023 年英语一大作文真题范文：传统文化焕发新活力
picture.prompt: 图画：村庄的河上正举行龙舟赛，两艘龙舟奋力竞渡，两岸人群摇旗欢呼。角落一位老人笑着说：“咱村的龙舟赛越来越热闹了。”
picture.essay:
As is shown in the picture, a dragon boat race is held during the Dragon Boat Festival, attracting an increasingly large crowd along the bank. Young people join the race enthusiastically, which vividly demonstrates the vitality of traditional Chinese culture in modern society.

The picture conveys a profound message: traditional culture never becomes outdated if it is passed down and carried forward with enthusiasm. In recent years, elements of Chinese tradition — from Hanfu and calligraphy to folk festivals and local operas — have returned to the public eye and won the hearts of the younger generation. This revival not only preserves our cultural roots but also strengthens our national confidence and sense of identity. The dragon boat, once a symbol of ancient customs, has become a bridge connecting the past and the present.

In my opinion, young people should take the initiative to inherit and innovate our cultural heritage, combining tradition with modern ways of expression. Only in this way can our splendid culture remain vigorous forever and shine more brightly on the world stage.
picture.translation:
如图所示，端午节期间举行了一场龙舟赛，岸边聚集了越来越多的人群。年轻人热情地参与其中，生动地展示了中国传统文化在现代社会中的活力。

这幅图传达了一个深刻的道理：只要怀着热情去传承与发扬，传统文化永远不会过时。近年来，从汉服、书法到民俗节日和地方戏曲，中国传统元素重新回到公众视野，赢得了年轻一代的喜爱。这种复兴不仅守护了我们的文化根脉，也增强了民族自信与认同感。曾经作为古老习俗象征的龙舟，如今已成为连接过去与现在的桥梁。

在我看来，年轻人应主动继承并创新文化遗产，将传统与现代表达方式相结合。唯有如此，我们灿烂的文化才能永葆活力，在世界舞台上绽放更加耀眼的光芒。
picture.comment: 首段以“现场感”描写切入，第二段从现象上升到文化复兴与民族自信，末段落到年轻人的责任。从具体到抽象的升华是文化类话题的得分要点。

picture.title: 2024 年英语一大作文真题范文：公园增多，民生幸福
picture.prompt: 图+表：某市近三年公园数量逐年增加，配图表显示绿化面积持续扩大。主题：城市建设与人民福祉。
picture.essay:
As is clearly presented in the picture and the table, the number of parks in a certain city has increased year by year over the past three years, with the green area expanding steadily. The data speaks for itself: urban construction has been progressing rapidly and remarkably.

What the material conveys is that urban development should always put people's wellbeing first. Parks are not merely places for leisure; they improve air quality, provide space for exercise and family gathering, and relieve the stress of modern city life. The growing number of parks reflects a shift in the philosophy of urban governance — from pursuing mere economic growth to building a greener, healthier and more livable environment. Behind every newly opened park lies the government's determination to respond to people's needs and improve their quality of life.

In conclusion, the increasing parks symbolize the progress of our society in both material and spiritual terms. It is hoped that more cities will follow this path, so that every resident can breathe fresh air, enjoy green scenery, and live a happier life.
picture.translation:
如图和表所示，某市近三年公园数量逐年增加，绿化面积持续扩大。数据不言自明：城市建设正在快速而显著地推进。

材料传达的是：城市发展应始终把人民福祉放在首位。公园不仅仅是休闲场所，它们改善空气质量，为锻炼和家庭聚会提供空间，还能缓解现代城市生活的压力。公园数量的增长反映了城市治理理念的转变——从单纯追求经济增长转向建设更绿色、更健康、更宜居的环境。每一座新公园的背后，都是政府回应人民需求、提升生活质量的决心。

总之，公园的增多象征着我们的社会在物质与精神两方面的进步。希望更多城市能走上这条路，让每位居民都能呼吸新鲜空气、欣赏绿色风景、过上更幸福的生活。
picture.comment: 图表题首段要点名数据趋势（year by year / steadily），第二段先讲公园的多重价值再升华到治理理念转变，末段展望。数据描述简洁、主题升华自然。

picture.title: 2025 年英语一大作文真题范文：生活水平显著提升
picture.prompt: 表格：2014-2023 年全国居民平均每百户年末主要耐用消费品拥有量变化（电冰箱、空调、洗衣机等逐年上升）。主题：人民生活水平的提升。
picture.essay:
As is clearly shown in the table, from 2014 to 2023 the average number of major durable consumer goods — such as refrigerators, air conditioners and washing machines — owned by every hundred households nationwide rose steadily year by year. The data vividly mirrors the remarkable improvement in people's living standards.

The table is intended to demonstrate the fruits of economic development and social progress. The growing possession of household appliances indicates that families today are better able to afford a more comfortable and convenient life than ever before. Behind this upward trend lie rising incomes, advanced manufacturing and a mature consumer market, which together have turned many once-luxurious goods into everyday necessities. Moreover, such progress reflects the successful transformation of our country's economy and the constant improvement of the people's sense of gain and happiness.

In conclusion, the changes in household ownership are a convincing footnote to China's development story. We have every reason to believe that, as the economy continues to grow, the quality of life will keep improving and the whole nation will share in even greater prosperity.
picture.translation:
如表所示，从 2014 年到 2023 年，全国居民平均每百户年末拥有电冰箱、空调、洗衣机等主要耐用消费品的数量逐年稳步上升。这些数据生动地反映了人民生活水平的显著提高。

这张表旨在展示经济发展和社会进步的成果。家用电器拥有量的增长表明，如今的家庭比以往任何时候都更有能力享受更舒适、更便捷的生活。在上升趋势的背后，是收入增长、制造业进步和成熟的消费市场，它们共同使许多曾经的奢侈品变成了日常必需品。此外，这种进步反映了我国经济转型的成功和人民群众获得感、幸福感的不断提升。

总之，家庭拥有量的变化是中国发展故事令人信服的注脚。我们有充分理由相信，随着经济持续增长，生活质量将不断提高，全国人民将共享更大的繁荣。
picture.comment: 表格题首段概括时间段与总体趋势，第二段剖析原因（收入、产业、市场）并升华到获得感，末段展望。注意把数据“翻译”成意义，而不是罗列数字——这是图表作文的高分关键。

picture.title: 2026 年英语一大作文真题范文：科技点亮老龄化社会
picture.prompt: 双图表：消费者对养老机器人的接受度调查（完全接受 27.9%、部分接受 24.9%、不接受 46.3%）；购买关注因素（便利性 39.3%、安全性 32.8%、价格 10.7%）。主题：科技在老龄化社会中的角色。
picture.essay:
As the two charts reveal, consumers hold divided attitudes toward elderly-care robots: only 27.9% fully accept them, 24.9% partly accept them, while as many as 46.3% refuse to accept them. Meanwhile, when it comes to purchasing, convenience (39.3%) and safety (32.8%) are the two factors consumers care about most, far ahead of price (10.7%).

The charts are intended to draw our attention to a significant issue: how technology can serve an aging society. With the elderly population growing rapidly, robots that assist daily care have real value in easing the burden on families and medical systems. However, the low acceptance rate warns us that technological progress alone is not enough — people's concerns about safety and usability must be addressed. Only when robots become genuinely safe, convenient and trustworthy can they win public trust and truly benefit the elderly.

In my view, the government, enterprises and society should work together to improve product quality, strengthen safety standards and raise public awareness. In this way, technology can become a warm hand that supports our parents and grandparents in their later years.
picture.translation:
这两张图表显示，消费者对养老机器人的态度存在分歧：只有 27.9% 的人完全接受，24.9% 部分接受，而多达 46.3% 的人不接受。同时，在购买时，便利性（39.3%）和安全性（32.8%）是消费者最关心的两个因素，远高于价格（10.7%）。

图表旨在引起我们对一个重要问题的关注：科技如何服务于老龄化社会。随着老年人口快速增长，辅助日常照护的机器人确实能够减轻家庭和医疗系统的负担。然而，较低的接受率提醒我们，仅有技术进步是不够的——人们对安全性和易用性的担忧必须得到解决。只有当机器人真正安全、便捷、可信时，才能赢得公众信任，真正造福老年人。

在我看来，政府、企业和社会应共同努力，提升产品质量、加强安全标准、提高公众认知。这样，科技才能成为一双温暖的手，在父母和祖父母的晚年托举起他们。
picture.comment: 双图表题首段必须分别交代两张图的关键数据并做对比（27.9% vs 46.3%）；第二段先肯定价值再指出问题（接受率低），体现辩证思维；末段落到多方协作。数据引用精准、观点平衡，是“科技话题”的高分示范。

chart.title: 居民出游方式变化（英语二真题主题）
chart.prompt: 图表：2013-2018 年某城市居民出游方式占比变化（公共交通占比下降，自驾游占比上升）。
chart.essay:
As is illustrated in the chart above, the ways residents travel during holidays witnessed a remarkable change from 2013 to 2018. The proportion of people taking public transport declined steadily from 60% to 35%, while the percentage of self-driving trips soared from 20% to 45%.

Several factors may account for this trend. To begin with, with the rapid growth of the economy, an increasing number of families can afford private cars. Moreover, self-driving offers greater flexibility and comfort, allowing people to arrange their trips freely. Last but not least, the improvement of roads and highways has made long-distance driving much more convenient.

Considering the current trend, it is reasonable to predict that self-driving will continue to gain popularity in the years to come. In a nutshell, this trend reflects the improvement of living standards, and we should respond to it by promoting safe and green driving habits.
chart.translation:
如上图所示，2013 年到 2018 年间居民假期出游方式发生了显著变化。乘坐公共交通的比例从 60% 稳步下降到 35%，而自驾游的比例则从 20% 飙升至 45%。

造成这一趋势的因素有几个。首先，随着经济快速增长，越来越多的家庭买得起私家车。其次，自驾游更加灵活舒适，人们可以自由安排行程。最后，道路和高速公路的改善使长途驾驶更加方便。

考虑到当前趋势，可以合理预测自驾在未来几年将继续受到欢迎。总之，这一趋势反映了生活水平的提高，我们应该通过提倡安全、绿色的驾驶习惯来应对。
chart.comment: 数据描述具体（有数字对比），原因分析分三点（经济/灵活性/基础设施），结尾有预测。注意数据句式 witness a remarkable change 与 decline/soar 的动词替换。

chart.title: 2019 年英语二大作文真题范文：毕业生去向变化
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the destinations of undergraduate graduates from a certain university in 2013 and 2018 (employment, further study and starting a business). In your writing, you should 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
chart.essay:
The bar chart illustrates the destinations of undergraduate graduates from a certain university in 2013 and 2018. The most striking change is that the proportion of graduates choosing employment fell from 68.1% to 60.7%, while those pursuing further study rose markedly from 26.3% to 34.0%. Meanwhile, the share opting to start a business, though still small, doubled from 1.3% to 2.6%.

Several factors account for this shift. As the job market grows increasingly competitive, more students choose to continue their studies in order to enhance their competitiveness. At the same time, the government's supportive policies for entrepreneurship have encouraged a growing number of graduates to start their own businesses.

In my view, this trend reflects the diversification of graduates' career choices and their rational response to the changing society. Students should make their own decisions based on their interests and abilities rather than blindly following the trend.
chart.translation:
柱状图展示了一所高校 2013 年和 2018 年本科毕业生的毕业去向。最显著的变化是：选择就业的毕业生比例从 68.1% 下降到 60.7%，而继续深造的比例从 26.3% 明显上升到 34.0%。同时，选择创业的比例虽然仍很小，却从 1.3% 翻倍到 2.6%。

造成这一变化的原因有几个。随着就业市场竞争日益激烈，更多学生选择继续深造以提升竞争力。与此同时，政府鼓励创业的扶持政策也促使越来越多的毕业生自己创业。

在我看来，这一趋势反映了毕业生职业选择的多元化，以及他们对社会变化的理性应对。学生应根据自己的兴趣和能力做出决定，而不是盲目跟风。
chart.comment: 柱图对比题：先点出最显著变化（就业降、升学升），再提次要变化（创业翻倍）。原因分析紧扣“就业竞争+创业政策”，结尾强调理性选择——三个要点完整对应真题要求。

chart.title: 2020 年英语二大作文真题范文：大学生手机阅读目的
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the pie chart below, which shows the purposes of mobile phone reading among students at a certain university (learning knowledge 59.5%, killing time 21.3%, acquiring information 17.0%, others 2.2%).
chart.essay:
The pie chart above clearly illustrates the purposes of mobile phone reading among students at a certain university. As is shown, learning knowledge takes the largest share, accounting for 59.5%, followed by killing time at 21.3% and acquiring information at 17.0%, while other purposes make up merely 2.2%.

Several factors may account for this phenomenon. To begin with, mobile phones have become increasingly convenient, allowing students to access academic materials anytime and anywhere. Moreover, as competition grows fiercer, most students are well aware that reading for knowledge is essential to their future development.

In my view, it is a positive trend that the majority of students read to enrich their minds rather than merely to pass time. However, the proportion of time-killing reading is still worth our attention, and universities should guide students to use mobile devices in a more efficient way.
chart.translation:
上面的饼图清楚地展示了一所大学学生手机阅读的目的。如图所示，“学习知识”占比最大，达到 59.5%；其次是“消磨时间”，占 21.3%；“获取信息”占 17.0%；其他目的仅占 2.2%。

造成这一现象的原因有几个。首先，手机变得越来越方便，学生可以随时随地获取学习资料。此外，随着竞争日益激烈，大多数学生都清楚地认识到，为获取知识而阅读对他们的未来发展至关重要。

在我看来，大多数学生阅读是为了充实头脑而非消磨时间，这是一个积极的趋势。但消磨时间类阅读的比例仍值得关注，高校应引导学生更高效地使用手机。
chart.comment: 饼图题：描述占比排序（最大项+次项+末项）→原因（便捷性+竞争意识）→辩证评价（肯定主流+提醒隐患）。对占比较小的“其他”用 merely 一笔带过，避免流水账。

chart.title: 2021 年英语二大作文真题范文：居民锻炼方式偏好
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the bar chart below, which shows the ways residents of a certain city choose to take physical exercise (alone 54.3%, with friends 47.7%, with family 23.9%, group activities 15.8%).
chart.essay:
The bar chart illustrates the ways residents of a certain city choose to take physical exercise. As is clearly shown, exercising alone ranks first, accounting for 54.3%, closely followed by working out with friends at 47.7%. By contrast, far fewer people prefer to exercise with family members (23.9%) or to join group activities, which stands at the bottom with only 15.8%.

Several factors may account for this preference. On the one hand, exercising alone offers maximum flexibility, allowing busy urban dwellers to arrange their own schedules freely. On the other hand, the fast pace of modern life leaves people with limited time to coordinate with family or organize collective sports.

In my view, although individual exercise is convenient, its dominance is not entirely healthy. Group activities help build teamwork and strengthen social bonds. Therefore, communities should organize more sports events to encourage residents to exercise together.
chart.translation:
柱状图展示了某市居民选择的锻炼方式。如图所示，“独自锻炼”排名第一，占 54.3%；“和朋友一起锻炼”紧随其后，占 47.7%。相比之下，选择与家人一起锻炼（23.9%）和参加集体活动（15.8%）的人要少得多。

造成这种偏好的原因有几个。一方面，独自锻炼最为灵活，忙碌的城市居民可以自由安排时间。另一方面，现代生活节奏快，人们很难协调家人时间或组织集体运动。

在我看来，独自锻炼虽然方便，但一家独大并不完全健康。集体活动有助于培养团队精神和增进人际关系。因此，社区应多组织体育活动，鼓励居民一起锻炼。
chart.comment: 柱图对比题：描述高占比项目与低占比项目形成对比，原因用 On the one hand/On the other hand 正反分析，结尾从“个体便利”升华到“社交价值”，提出社区建议。

chart.title: 2022 年英语二大作文真题范文：快递业务量攀升
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the changes in China's express delivery volume from 2018 to 2020 (total rising from about 51 to 83 billion pieces; rural area from about 12 to 30 billion pieces).
chart.essay:
The bar chart shows the changes in China's express delivery volume from 2018 to 2020, covering both the national total and the rural area. During the three years, the total volume rose steadily from about 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces. More remarkably, the rural delivery volume soared from about 12 billion to 30 billion pieces, more than doubling within the period.

Several factors account for this rapid growth. To begin with, the booming e-commerce industry has made online shopping an indispensable part of daily life, which directly drives the demand for express delivery. Moreover, the improvement of rural logistics infrastructure and the popularity of livestreaming commerce have brought more farmers and rural residents into the online market.

In my view, the surge in express delivery reflects the vitality of China's digital economy and the narrowing gap between urban and rural areas. To sustain this trend, we should continue to improve logistics services and support rural e-commerce development.
chart.translation:
柱状图展示了 2018 年至 2020 年中国快递业务量的变化，包括全国总量和农村地区。三年间，总量从约 510 亿件稳步上升到 830 亿件。更值得注意的是，农村快递量从约 120 亿件猛增到 300 亿件，三年内翻了一倍多。

造成这种快速增长的原因有几个。首先，蓬勃发展的电子商务使网购成为日常生活中不可或缺的一部分，直接拉动了快递需求。此外，农村物流基础设施的改善和直播电商的普及，使更多农民和农村居民进入了线上市场。

在我看来，快递量的激增反映了中国数字经济的活力以及城乡差距的缩小。为保持这一趋势，我们应继续改善物流服务，支持农村电商发展。
chart.comment: 本题有“总体+农村”两组数据：先概括总体上升，再突出农村翻倍这一对比亮点（more than doubling）。原因紧扣电商+农村物流，结尾落到城乡协调发展，层次清晰。

chart.title: 2023 年英语二大作文真题范文：居民健康素养提升
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the line chart below, which shows the health literacy level of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021 (rising from 8.80% to 25.40%).
chart.essay:
The line chart illustrates the changing health literacy level of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. As is shown, the proportion of people with basic health literacy climbed steadily from a mere 8.80% in 2012 to 25.40% in 2021, nearly tripling over the decade, with the growth accelerating after 2016.

Several factors account for this encouraging upward trend. On the one hand, the government has invested heavily in public health education and disease prevention campaigns, which have greatly raised people's awareness of healthy lifestyles. On the other hand, with rising incomes and easier access to online information, ordinary people have grown more willing to learn how to protect their own health.

In my view, this rising curve reflects genuine social progress. Nevertheless, since the figure still leaves much room for improvement, both individuals and society should continue their efforts to spread health knowledge and build a healthier nation.
chart.translation:
折线图展示了 2012 年至 2021 年中国居民健康素养水平的变化。如图所示，具备基本健康素养的人口比例从 2012 年的 8.80% 稳步上升到 2021 年的 25.40%，十年间翻了近三倍，且 2016 年后增长明显加快。

造成这一令人鼓舞的上升趋势的原因有几个。一方面，政府在公共卫生教育和疾病预防宣传方面投入巨大，大大提高了人们对健康生活方式的认识。另一方面，随着收入增长和网络信息获取更加便捷，普通人越来越愿意学习如何保护自己的健康。

在我看来，这条上升曲线反映了社会的真正进步。不过，这一比例仍有很大提升空间，个人和社会都应继续努力传播健康知识，建设更健康的中国。
chart.comment: 折线图题：强调趋势（steady climb + 加速增长）+ 具体数字（8.80%→25.40%，nearly tripling）。原因从政府投入和个人意识双线展开，结尾既肯定成绩又指出空间，辩证收束。

chart.title: 2024 年英语二大作文真题范文：劳动实践课收获
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the bar chart below, which shows the main gains of students from a university's labor practice course (knowledge 91.3%, hands-on ability 84.8%, relaxation 54.4%, cooperation 32.6%).
chart.essay:
As is shown in the bar chart, a survey on students' main gains from a university's labor practice course lists four benefits. Learning relevant knowledge tops the list at 91.3%, closely followed by improved hands-on ability at 84.8%. Feeling relaxed accounts for 54.4%, while enhanced cooperation ranks lowest, at only 32.6%.

Behind these figures lies a clear message. That knowledge and practical skills score so high suggests such courses effectively combine theory with practice, which is exactly their design purpose. The low figure for cooperation, however, may indicate that most tasks are completed individually, offering students few chances to work as a team.

In my view, labor practice deserves greater emphasis in schools, for it cultivates abilities that textbooks alone cannot. Meanwhile, educators should redesign group-based tasks so that cooperation and teamwork can also be fostered.
chart.translation:
如图所示，一项关于某高校劳动实践课学生主要收获的调查列出了四项益处。“学习相关知识”以 91.3% 居首，“动手能力提升”紧随其后，占 84.8%；“身心放松”占 54.4%；而“合作能力增强”比例最低，仅为 32.6%。

这些数字背后传达了一个明确的信息：知识和实践技能得分如此之高，说明这类课程有效地将理论与实践结合起来，这正是其设计初衷。而合作能力得分低，则可能意味着大多数任务由个人独立完成，学生缺少团队合作的机会。

在我看来，学校应更加重视劳动实践课，因为它能培养课本无法传授的能力。同时，教育者应重新设计小组任务，让学生也能在合作与团队中成长。
chart.comment: 本题的得分点在于“解读数据背后的原因”：高分的知识/技能（对应课程设计初衷）与低分的合作（暗示任务模式问题）形成对比分析，结尾针对问题提建议——比单纯罗列数据高出一个层次。

chart.title: 2025 年英语二大作文真题范文：老年人休闲活动
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the bar chart below, which shows the main leisure activities of the elderly in a certain community (watching TV 90.8%, taking a walk 68.3%, growing flowers 34.7%, reading 31.8%, playing chess 18.4%).
chart.essay:
The bar chart clearly illustrates the main leisure activities of the elderly in a certain community. As is shown, watching TV ranks far ahead of the rest, chosen by 90.8% of the respondents, followed by taking a walk at 68.3%. By contrast, growing flowers and reading account for only 34.7% and 31.8% respectively, while playing chess sits at the bottom, favored by merely 18.4%.

These figures reveal that passive and effortless pastimes clearly dominate the daily lives of senior citizens. Watching TV and walking cost little and demand neither special skills nor companions, so they naturally appeal to the majority. In contrast, hobbies such as chess or gardening require more energy, patience or partners, which explains their limited popularity.

In my view, this pattern is understandable but not entirely desirable. Communities should organize more varied activities for the elderly and provide learning opportunities, so that they can enjoy richer and healthier lives in their later years.
chart.translation:
柱状图清晰地展示了一个社区老年人的主要休闲活动。如图所示，“看电视”以 90.8% 遥遥领先，“散步”以 68.3% 位居第二。相比之下，“养花”和“阅读”分别仅占 34.7% 和 31.8%，而“下棋”以 18.4% 排在最后。

这些数据表明，被动、不费力的消遣方式明显主导了老年人的日常生活。看电视和散步花费少，既不需要特殊技能也不需要同伴，自然受到大多数人的青睐。相比之下，下棋、养花等爱好需要更多精力、耐心或同伴，这解释了它们受欢迎程度有限的原因。

在我看来，这种状况可以理解但并不完全理想。社区应为老年人组织更多样化的活动并提供学习机会，让他们在晚年享受更丰富、更健康的生活。
chart.comment: 多项柱图题：抓“断层”对比（90.8% vs 18.4%），用“被动/主动”归类解释两极分化（被动活动零门槛 vs 主动爱好有门槛），结尾从数据落到适老化服务建议。

chart.title: 2026 年英语二大作文真题范文：儿童户外活动价值
chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on the bar chart below, which shows a survey on people's views of the value of children's outdoor activities (satisfying curiosity 54.60%, developing observation 54.50%, building a strong body 37.20%, enhancing parent-child interaction 33.20%).
chart.essay:
The bar chart illustrates the results of a survey on people's views of children's outdoor activities. As is shown, the two most valued benefits are satisfying curiosity and developing observation, cited by 54.60% and 54.50% of respondents respectively. By contrast, building a strong body and enhancing parent-child interaction were selected by only 37.20% and 33.20%, noticeably lower figures.

Several factors account for this distribution. In an era that prizes intellectual growth, many parents regard outdoor activities primarily as a channel for stimulating children's minds. Physical benefits, though obvious, are often taken for granted, while parent-child interaction is likely overshadowed by busy work schedules.

In my view, while cultivating curiosity and observation is indeed important, we should not overlook the physical and emotional value of outdoor activities. Families and schools should work together to ensure that children enjoy outdoor time that is both intellectually and physically rewarding.
chart.translation:
柱状图展示了一项关于人们对儿童户外活动价值看法的调查结果。如图所示，最受认可的两项价值是“满足好奇心”和“培养观察力”，分别有 54.60% 和 54.50% 的受访者选择。相比之下，选择“强健体魄”和“增进亲子互动”的比例只有 37.20% 和 33.20%，明显偏低。

造成这种分布的原因有几个。在这个重视智力成长的时代，许多家长把户外活动主要看作激发孩子思维的途径。身体锻炼的好处虽然显而易见，却常被视为理所当然；而亲子互动则很可能被忙碌的工作安排挤占。

在我看来，培养好奇心和观察力固然重要，但我们也不应忽视户外活动在身体和情感方面的价值。家庭和学校应共同努力，确保孩子们享受既益智又健体的户外时光。
chart.comment: 2026 最新真题：描述两组数据对比（认知类价值 vs 身体/情感类价值）→分析“重智力轻体魄”的社会心态→结尾呼吁全面平衡。数据引用准确、观点时代感强。

letter.title: 给外国朋友推荐旅游地（邀请/推荐信）
letter.prompt: Directions: Write an email to a foreign friend who is coming to visit China, recommending one place you think is worth visiting.
letter.essay:
Dear Tom,

I am writing to recommend a place that I am sure you will enjoy during your visit to China: the ancient city of Xi'an.

The reason why I make this recommendation is that Xi'an is the cradle of Chinese civilization. First of all, you can marvel at the Terracotta Warriors, one of the world's greatest archaeological discoveries. Besides, the city wall, which is the best-preserved ancient city wall in China, offers a fantastic cycling experience. What's more, you should not miss the local food, especially the famous biangbiang noodles, which are absolutely delicious.

I am confident that Xi'an will not only broaden your understanding of Chinese history but also leave you with unforgettable memories. Looking forward to your early reply.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的汤姆：

我写这封信是想向你推荐一个你来中国期间一定会喜欢的地方：古城西安。

我推荐它的原因是西安是中华文明的摇篮。首先，你可以惊叹于兵马俑，它是世界上最伟大的考古发现之一。其次，城墙是中国保存最完好的古城墙，在上面骑车是非常棒的体验。此外，你千万不要错过当地美食，尤其是著名的 biangbiang 面，味道绝对一流。

我相信西安不仅能加深你对中国历史的理解，还会给你留下难忘的回忆。期待你的早日回复。

你真诚的，李明
letter.comment: 应用文要点齐全：目的（写这封信的目的）→ 理由 → 具体内容（三点）→ 结尾期待回复。语气友好自然，使用了 not only...but also 结构。

letter.title: 2019 年英语一小作文真题范文：回复邮件（介绍支教项目）
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose you are working for the "Aiding Rural Primary School" project of your university. Write an email to answer the inquiry from an international student volunteer, specifying the details of the project. You should write about 100 words.
letter.essay:
Dear International Student,

I am writing in response to your inquiry about the "Aiding Rural Primary School" project of our university, and I am glad to introduce it to you.

This project, which has been running for five years, aims to improve the English teaching of rural primary schools in remote areas. Every summer, about forty volunteers are sent to five schools, where they teach English, organize reading activities and accompany the children during the vacation. Volunteers receive free accommodation and a small subsidy, and the whole program lasts about four weeks. Applications are open until the end of this month, and you are more than welcome to join us.

If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me. I sincerely hope to see you on our team this summer.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的国际学生：

我写这封邮件是为了回复您关于我们大学“援助乡村小学”项目的咨询，很高兴向您介绍这个项目。

该项目已运行五年，旨在提升偏远地区乡村小学的英语教学质量。每年暑假，约四十名志愿者被派往五所学校，教授英语、组织阅读活动，并在假期陪伴孩子们。志愿者可享受免费食宿和少量补贴，整个项目为期约四周。报名截止到本月底，非常欢迎您加入我们。

如果您还有其他问题，请随时与我联系。真诚希望今年夏天能在团队中见到您。

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 回复咨询信标准结构：表明来意→介绍项目（时间/内容/待遇/报名）→邀请与联系方式。信息点覆盖完整（对应真题要求 specified details），语气友好。

letter.title: 2021 年英语一小作文真题范文：建议信（在华求职）
letter.prompt: Directions: A foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write him/her an email to make some suggestions. You should write about 100 words.
letter.essay:
Dear Jack,

I am delighted to learn that you plan to find a job in China, and I am writing to offer you some suggestions.

To begin with, I suggest that you improve your Chinese, since the language is essential both for daily life and for most positions. Besides, it would be wise to learn about Chinese workplace culture, such as the importance of punctuality and teamwork. What's more, you had better send your applications through official channels and prepare carefully for interviews. Finally, you may want to start with a company that values international talents, which will make your adaptation much easier.

I am confident that you will find a satisfactory job soon. Wish you every success in China!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的杰克：

得知你打算来中国找工作，我很高兴，写信给你提一些建议。

首先，我建议你提高中文水平，因为无论是日常生活还是大多数职位，语言都必不可少。其次，了解中国的职场文化是明智的，比如守时和团队合作的重要性。此外，最好通过正规渠道投递简历，并认真准备面试。最后，你可以考虑先进入重视国际人才的公司，这样适应起来会容易得多。

我相信你很快就会找到满意的工作。祝你在中国一切顺利！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 建议信要点：祝贺/肯定对方计划→给出 2-3 条具体可行的建议→表达祝愿。用 To begin with / Besides / What's more / Finally 层层递进，建议落地可执行。

letter.title: 2022 年英语一小作文真题范文：邀请信（国际创新大赛）
letter.prompt: Directions: Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organize a team for the international innovation contest to be held at your university. You should write about 100 words.
letter.essay:
Dear Professor Johnson,

On behalf of our university, I am writing to invite you to organize a team to participate in the International Innovation Contest, which will be held at our university this May.

The contest aims to inspire creative thinking and international cooperation among young students. Each participating team is expected to present an innovative project, and teams from several countries will compete on the same stage. We believe that with your expertise and experience, the team you organize will make an excellent performance. Your university and students will be warmly welcomed, and we will provide full assistance with travel and accommodation.

We would be honored to have you and your team join the contest. I am looking forward to your favorable reply.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的约翰逊教授：

我代表我校写信，邀请您组队参加今年五月在我校举办的国际创新大赛。

本次大赛旨在激发青年学生的创新思维，促进国际合作。每支参赛队伍需要展示一个创新项目，届时多国队伍将同台竞技。我们相信，凭借您的专业知识和丰富经验，您带领的队伍一定会表现出色。我们热烈欢迎贵校师生的到来，并将为差旅和住宿提供全面协助。

我们深感荣幸能邀请您和您的团队参赛。期待您的佳音。

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 邀请信结构：发出邀请→介绍赛事背景→表达对对方的认可与支持→期待回复。本题需体现正式与尊重（on behalf of / would be honored to），并给出竞赛的关键信息。

letter.title: 2024 年英语一小作文真题范文：回复邮件（口头报告建议）
letter.prompt: Directions: Read the email from Paul, an international student who has to make an oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist and asks for advice. Write a reply in about 100 words.
letter.essay:
Dear Paul,

I am glad to help you with your oral report on an ancient Chinese scientist, and I have a good candidate for you: Zhang Heng, a great scientist of the Eastern Han Dynasty.

Here are some tips for your preparation. First, search for information about his inventions, especially the seismoscope, and note down the key facts. Second, organize your report into three parts: his life, his achievements and his influence, so that it is clear and logical. Third, practice aloud several times and pay attention to your pronunciation and pace. If you like, I can read your draft and offer some suggestions after you finish it.

I am sure you will give an excellent presentation. Best of luck!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的保罗：

很高兴能帮你准备关于中国古代科学家的口头报告，我为你推荐一位合适的人选：东汉伟大的科学家张衡。

以下是一些准备建议。首先，查找关于他发明（尤其是地动仪）的资料，记下关键事实。其次，把报告分成三个部分：生平、成就和影响，这样会清晰有条理。第三，大声练习几遍，注意发音和语速。如果你愿意，完成初稿后我可以帮你看看并提出建议。

相信你一定会做出一场精彩的展示。祝你好运！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 回复建议邮件：先回应对方求助并给出具体建议（人物推荐+三步准备法），再提供进一步帮助。针对性强、步骤清晰，符合“给建议”的真题要求。

letter.title: 2025 年英语一小作文真题范文：回复邮件（青年工匠展示）
letter.prompt: Directions: Read the email from Paul, who is curious about the craftsmen demonstration you are organizing and wants to help. Write a reply in about 100 words.
letter.essay:
Dear Paul,

Thank you for your interest in the demonstration by young craftsmen on campus, and I am happy to tell you more about it.

The craftsmen will show traditional skills such as paper-cutting, clay sculpture and kite-making, and they will explain the stories behind these crafts. The demonstration will take place next Friday afternoon on the campus square, and students will have a chance to try some of the crafts by themselves.

It is very kind of you to offer your help. You could help us set up the display boards in the morning and take photos during the activity, if that is convenient for you. Thank you again, and I look forward to working with you!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的保罗：

感谢你对校园青年工匠展示活动的关注，很高兴为你介绍更多信息。

工匠们将展示剪纸、泥塑、风筝制作等传统技艺，并讲解这些手工艺背后的故事。展示活动将于下周五下午在校园广场举行，同学们将有机会亲手尝试部分工艺。

你能主动提供帮助真是太贴心了。如果方便的话，你可以上午帮我们布置展板，活动期间帮忙拍照。再次感谢，期待与你合作！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 回复信息咨询+接受帮助的邮件：先回答对方问题（展示内容/时间/互动安排），再回应帮忙的意愿并具体安排分工。信息完整、语气热情，兼顾两个要点。

letter.title: 2026 年英语一小作文真题范文：回复邮件（手写家书）
letter.prompt: Directions: Read the email from Paul, who was moved by the Chinese handwritten letters you posted and wants to know more about them. Write a reply in about 100 words.
letter.essay:
Dear Paul,

I am so glad that you were moved by the handwritten letters, and I am happy to tell you more about them.

The letters were written by Chinese families to their loved ones, expressing deep feelings that are hard to put into words. They are part of an exhibition organized by our city museum, which shows how people communicated with each other in the days before the Internet. The exhibition will be open to the public until the end of this month, so I strongly suggest you go and see them in person. I would be very happy to accompany you there and explain the stories behind some of the letters if you are interested.

I am looking forward to hearing your thoughts about the exhibition!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的保罗：

很高兴这些手写家书打动了你，很乐意为你介绍更多。

这些信是中国的家庭写给亲人的，表达了难以言表的深情。它们是市博物馆举办的一个展览的一部分，展示了互联网时代之前人们的交流方式。展览将向公众开放到本月底，所以我强烈建议你亲自去看看。如果你感兴趣，我很乐意陪你一起去，并为你讲解其中一些信件背后的故事。

期待听到你对展览的看法！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 本题与 2026 大作文同题（手写家书），小作文为回复信：回应感受→介绍背景（展览信息）→发出邀约。注意本题是“回复朋友”而非“写给父母”，文体是 email 而非家书。

letter.title: 2019 年英语二小作文真题范文：辩论主题建议邮件
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose Professor Smith asked you to plan a debate on the theme of city traffic. Write him an email to 1) suggest a specific topic with your reasons, and 2) tell him about your arrangements.
letter.essay:
Dear Professor Smith,

I am writing to share my plan for the debate on city traffic, as you requested.

I would like to suggest the topic "Should private cars be restricted from entering the city centre?" This subject invites clear arguments on both sides, as it links traffic congestion with people's daily convenience, making it lively to debate.

As for the arrangements, I have booked Lecture Hall B for this Friday afternoon. Eight students will be divided into two teams, each given ten minutes to state their views, followed by a free discussion. I do hope you can attend and offer us your guidance.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
尊敬的史密斯教授：

应您的要求，我写信汇报城市交通辩论的策划方案。

我建议的辩题是“私家车是否应该被限制进入市中心？”这个题目正反双方都有充分的论据，因为它把交通拥堵与人们的日常便利联系在一起，辩论起来会很激烈。

关于安排，我已预订了本周五下午的 B 号报告厅。八名学生将分成两队，每队有十分钟陈述观点，之后是自由讨论。非常希望您能出席并给予指导。

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 本题要求同时完成“建议主题+说明安排”两件事：辩题要具体且有可辩性（给出理由），安排要具体（时间/地点/流程）。两段分别对应真题 1) 2) 两点，结构清晰。

letter.title: 2020 年英语二小作文真题范文：历史遗址参观邮件
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose you are planning a tour of a historical site for a group of international students. Write an email to 1) tell them about the site, and 2) give them some tips for the tour.
letter.essay:
Dear International Students,

I am writing to tell you about the historical site we are going to visit this Saturday: the ancient city wall of Xi'an, one of the best-preserved city walls in China.

Built over 600 years ago, the wall surrounds the old city and offers a wonderful view of both ancient and modern Xi'an. We will meet at the school gate at 8:30 a.m. and take the subway together. Please remember to wear comfortable shoes, since we will walk a lot, and bring some water and snacks with you. If the weather turns rainy, we will postpone the tour to next Saturday.

I am looking forward to a pleasant day with all of you!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的国际学生们：

我写信是想告诉大家本周六我们将参观的历史遗迹：西安古城墙，它是中国保存最完好的城墙之一。

这座城墙有六百多年历史，环绕老城，既能欣赏古代建筑也能眺望现代西安。我们将在早上 8:30 在校门口集合，一起乘地铁前往。请大家穿舒适的鞋子，因为要走很多路，并自带水和零食。如果下雨，我们将把参观推迟到下周六。

期待与大家共度愉快的一天！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: “介绍+建议”双任务邮件：先介绍景点特色（历史价值+游览价值），再给实用建议（着装/补给/雨天预案）。信息点完整、体贴周到，是组织类邮件的高分示范。

letter.title: 2021 年英语二小作文真题范文：线上会议邀请邮件
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose you are organizing an online meeting. Write an email to Jack, an international student, to 1) invite him to participate, and 2) tell him the details.
letter.essay:
Dear Jack,

I am writing to invite you to participate in an online meeting about cultural exchange between Chinese and international students.

The meeting will be held this Saturday evening from 7:00 to 8:30 p.m. via Tencent Meeting, and the meeting link and password will be sent to your email one hour before it starts. During the meeting, we will share our experiences of studying abroad and discuss how to help international students adapt to campus life more quickly. Your views will be greatly valued, as you can offer a unique perspective on this topic.

I do hope you can join us. If you have any questions about the meeting, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的杰克：

我写信邀请你参加一场关于中外学生文化交流的线上会议。

会议将于本周六晚上 7:00 至 8:30 通过腾讯会议举行，会议链接和密码将在开始前一小时发送到你的邮箱。会议期间，我们将分享留学经历，并讨论如何帮助国际学生更快适应校园生活。你的观点将非常宝贵，因为你能为这个话题提供独特的视角。

非常希望你能参加。如果你对会议有任何疑问，请随时联系我。

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 线上会议邀请：给出时间平台等关键细节（通过/链接/时长），说明会议内容并强调对方参与的价值（unique perspective），让对方感到被重视——邀请信的加分点。

letter.title: 2022 年英语二小作文真题范文：校园美食节邀请邮件
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose you are planning a campus food festival. Write an email to the international students in your university to 1) introduce the food festival, and 2) invite them to participate.
letter.essay:
Dear International Students,

I am delighted to tell you that our university is going to hold a campus food festival next Friday, and all international students are warmly invited to take part.

The festival will be held on the campus square from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Students from different regions will set up booths to display their local specialties, and there will be cooking shows and a food-tasting activity. We would love to see you share the flavors of your hometown as well. If you are interested in setting up a booth or performing a cooking show, please sign up before this Wednesday by replying to this email.

We sincerely hope you can join us in this feast of tastes and cultures!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的国际学生们：

很高兴地告诉大家，我校将于下周五举办校园美食节，诚挚邀请所有国际学生参加。

美食节将于上午 10 点至下午 4 点在校园广场举行。来自不同地区的学生将设置摊位展示当地特色美食，届时还有厨艺表演和品鉴活动。我们非常希望你们也能分享家乡的风味。如果有兴趣设摊位或进行厨艺展示，请在周三前回复本邮件报名。

真诚期待大家加入这场味觉与文化的盛宴！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 介绍+邀请双任务：先给活动基本信息（时间地点内容），再重点邀请国际学生参与并开放报名通道（给予参与方式）。结尾用 feast of tastes and cultures 点题，感染力强。

letter.title: 2023 年英语二小作文真题范文：建议信（艺术展与机器人展）
letter.prompt: Directions: An art exhibition and a robot show are to be held on Sunday, and your friend David asks you which one he should go to. Write him an email to 1) make a suggestion, and 2) give your reason(s).
letter.essay:
Dear David,

I am glad to help you choose between the two shows this Sunday, and I suggest you go to the robot show.

The robot show will display the latest robots designed by universities and companies, including robots that can serve food, play chess and even draw pictures. You have always been fascinated by technology, and this show will definitely satisfy your curiosity and give you a close look at how these machines work. Besides, many of the robots are interactive, so you can try operating one yourself, which is a rare opportunity.

The art exhibition is also wonderful, but the robot show suits your interests much better. I believe you will enjoy it!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的戴维：

很高兴帮你在这周日的两场展览中做出选择，我建议你去机器人展。

机器人展将展示由高校和企业设计的最新机器人，包括能送餐、下棋甚至画画的机器人。你一直对科技着迷，这次展览一定能满足你的好奇心，让你近距离了解这些机器是如何工作的。此外，很多机器人可以互动，你可以亲自尝试操作，这是难得的机会。

艺术展也很精彩，但机器人展更符合你的兴趣。相信你会喜欢的！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 建议信（二选一）：明确给出建议→用对方兴趣（fascinated by technology）作为核心理由→补充活动亮点强化说服力→委婉处理未选项。针对性强的理由比泛泛而谈更有说服力。

letter.title: 2024 年英语二小作文真题范文：古镇老屋调查计划邮件
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose you and Jack are going to do a survey on the protection of old houses in an ancient town. Write him an email to 1) put forward your plan, and 2) ask for his opinion.
letter.essay:
Dear Jack,

I am writing to share my plan for our survey on the protection of old houses in the ancient town, and I would like to hear your opinion.

My plan is as follows. First, we will visit the ancient town next weekend and interview local residents, especially the elderly who know the history of these houses well. Second, we will take photos and record the current condition of the old houses, focusing on those that are damaged or abandoned. Third, we will search for related policies on cultural heritage protection online and compare them with the actual situation we observe.

After that, we can write a short report together. What do you think of this plan? Please let me know if you have any suggestions, and I am sure we can make it better.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的杰克：

我写信是想与你分享关于古镇老屋保护调查的计划，也希望听听你的意见。

我的计划如下：首先，我们下周末去古镇实地走访，采访当地居民，尤其是了解这些老屋历史的老人。其次，我们将拍摄照片，记录老屋现状，重点关注受损或废弃的房屋。第三，我们将在网上查阅文化遗产保护的相关政策，并与实际观察到的情况进行对比。

之后我们可以一起写一份简短的报告。你觉得这个计划怎么样？如果有任何建议请告诉我，相信我们能让它更完善。

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 计划征询邮件：用 First/Second/Third 把调查步骤列清楚（实地走访→记录现状→政策对比），结尾主动征询意见并表达开放态度。结构化的计划让对方容易评估和补充。

letter.title: 2025 年英语二小作文真题范文：经典小说短剧邀请邮件
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose you are planning a short play based on a classic Chinese novel. Write your friend John an email to 1) introduce the play, and 2) invite him to take part in it.
letter.essay:
Dear John,

I am excited to tell you that I am planning a short play based on the classic Chinese novel "Journey to the West", and I would like to invite you to take part in it.

The play will adapt one of the most famous episodes of the novel, in which the Monkey King defeats the White Bone Demon, and it will be performed at the campus cultural festival next month. We have already gathered a small team of students who are passionate about drama, and we plan to rehearse twice a week.

I know you enjoy acting, and your English is excellent, which will be a great help to our performance. I would be very happy if you could join us as one of the main actors. Let me know if you are interested!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的约翰：

很高兴地告诉你，我正在筹备一部根据中国古典小说《西游记》改编的短剧，想邀请你参加。

该剧将改编小说中最著名的情节之一——孙悟空三打白骨精，并将在下个月的校园文化节上演出。我们已经召集了一小群热爱戏剧的学生，计划每周排练两次。

我知道你喜欢表演，而且你的英语非常出色，这对我们的演出将大有帮助。如果你能加入我们担任主演之一，我将非常高兴。有兴趣的话请告诉我！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 介绍+邀请双任务：介绍剧本来源与演出安排（时间/团队/排练），邀请时用对方优势（喜欢表演+英语好）打动对方。改编经典主题的选材本身就能引起兴趣。

letter.title: 2026 年英语二小作文真题范文：旅行视频回复邮件
letter.prompt: Directions: Suppose your friend Jack has shared with you a video of his family's travel in China. Write an email to tell him 1) how you feel about the video, and 2) your wish to learn more about their travel.
letter.essay:
Dear Jack,

Thank you so much for sharing the wonderful video of your family's trip to China. I have watched it three times, and I was truly amazed by the stunning scenery and the warm smiles on everyone's faces. It really made my day!

Now I would love to learn more about your journey. Could you tell me which cities you visited and which place impressed you most? I am also curious about the local food you tried during the trip. Your descriptions will certainly help me plan my own visit one day.

Please share more stories and photos when you are free. Looking forward to hearing from you soon!

Best regards,
Li Ming
letter.translation:
亲爱的杰克：

非常感谢你分享你们一家中国之行的精彩视频。我看了三遍，真的被迷人的风景和每个人脸上温暖的笑容所震撼。它让我一整天都心情很好！

现在我很想了解更多关于你们旅程的故事。你能告诉我你们去了哪些城市、哪个地方给你印象最深吗？我还很好奇你们在旅途中品尝了哪些当地美食。你的描述一定会帮助我将来规划自己的旅行。

有空请分享更多故事和照片。期待你的回信！

此致
敬礼
李明
letter.comment: 回复分享邮件：先真诚表达感受（看了三遍/被震撼/很开心）拉近距离，再用具体问题（城市/印象最深/美食）表达想了解更多，最后主动邀约更多分享。语气自然亲切，符合朋友间交流。

notice.title: 英语学习讲座通知
notice.prompt: Directions: The Student Union is going to hold a lecture on English learning. Write a notice to announce it.
notice.essay:
NOTICE

In order to help students improve their English learning efficiency, the Students' Union is going to hold a lecture titled "How to Master English Vocabulary". The lecture will be held at 7:00 p.m. on Friday, October 20, in the Lecture Hall of the Main Building.

The lecture will be delivered by Professor Wang from the School of Foreign Languages, who has over 20 years of experience in English teaching. The arrangements are as follows: first, the professor will share effective methods of memorizing words; second, there will be a Q&A session where students can raise their questions. Those who want to participate are required to sign up at the Students' Union office before Thursday.

We are looking forward to your active participation.

The Students' Union
notice.translation:
通知

为了帮助同学们提高英语学习效率，学生会将举办一场题为「如何掌握英语词汇」的讲座。讲座将于 10 月 20 日（周五）晚 7 点在主楼报告厅举行。

讲座由外国语学院王教授主讲，他有 20 多年英语教学经验。具体安排如下：首先，教授将分享记忆单词的有效方法；其次，设有问答环节，同学们可以提问。想参加的同学请于周四前到学生会办公室报名。

期待大家的积极参与。

学生会
notice.comment: 通知格式完整：标题 → 目的+时间地点 → 具体安排 → 参与要求 → 期待。被动语态（will be held、are required to）用得规范。

notice.title: 2020 年英语一小作文真题范文：通知（歌唱比赛）
notice.prompt: Directions: The Students' Union of your university has assigned you to inform the international students about an upcoming singing contest. Write a notice in about 100 words.
notice.essay:
Notice

To enrich the campus life of international students and promote cultural exchange, the Students' Union is going to hold a singing contest next Saturday, March 21st.

The contest will be held at 6:30 p.m. in the Student Activity Center. Any international student who loves singing is welcome to sign up before Thursday by sending an email to contest@university.edu.cn with your name and the song you intend to perform. All participants will receive a souvenir, and the top three singers will be awarded prizes.

We sincerely look forward to your active participation. Please come and enjoy a wonderful evening of music!

The Students' Union
notice.translation:
通知

为丰富国际学生的校园生活、促进文化交流，校学生会将于下周六（3 月 21 日）举办歌唱比赛。

比赛将于晚 6:30 在学生活动中心举行。凡热爱唱歌的国际学生均可报名，请在周四前将姓名和参赛歌曲发送至 contest@university.edu.cn。所有参赛者都将获得纪念品，前三名将获得奖品。

真诚期待大家的积极参与。欢迎前来享受一个美妙的音乐之夜！

校学生会
notice.comment: 通知写作要点：标题→目的→时间地点→参与要求→结尾号召。本题面向国际学生，语言需简洁明了，信息点（时间/地点/报名方式/奖励）缺一不可。

notice.title: 2023 年英语一小作文真题范文：通知（科研项目招募）
notice.prompt: Directions: Write a notice to recruit a student for Prof. Smith's research project on campus sports activities. Specify the duties and requirements of the job. Write your answer in about 100 words.
notice.essay:
Notice

Prof. Smith of the School of Physical Education is looking for a student assistant to join his research project on campus sports activities.

The assistant is expected to help collect and analyze data on students' participation in campus sports, assist in organizing questionnaires, and cooperate with the professor in writing the research report. The position requires about five hours of work per week, and the payment will be based on the university standard for student assistants.

Applicants should be undergraduate or postgraduate students with a good command of English, basic skills in data processing, and a strong sense of responsibility. If you are interested, please send your resume to smith.project@university.edu.cn before March 20th.

Prof. Smith's Research Team
notice.translation:
通知

体育学院史密斯教授正在为他的校园体育活动研究项目招募一名学生助理。

助理需要协助收集和分析学生参与校园体育的数据，帮助组织问卷调查，并与教授合作撰写研究报告。该岗位每周约需工作五小时，薪酬按学校学生助理标准发放。

申请人应为本科生或研究生，具备良好的英语水平、基本的数据处理能力和强烈的责任心。有意者请于 3 月 20 日前将简历发送至 smith.project@university.edu.cn。

史密斯教授研究团队
notice.comment: 招募通知要覆盖真题要求的两个要点：duties（职责）与 requirements（要求）。职责分点列出，要求明确（学历/能力/品质），结尾给出联系方式与截止时间。

argumentation.title: 养成阅读好习惯的重要性（四六级真题主题）
argumentation.prompt: Directions: Write an essay on the importance of developing a good habit of reading.
argumentation.essay:
Nowadays, there is a growing concern over the decline of reading among young people, as smartphones increasingly occupy their spare time.

From my perspective, the benefits of developing a good habit of reading far outweigh its costs. In the first place, reading broadens our horizons, enabling us to learn about different cultures and ideas without leaving home. In the second place, regular reading sharpens our thinking and improves our writing and speaking abilities. There is no denying that a well-read person is more likely to express himself clearly and persuasively. A case in point is that most top students attribute their outstanding performance to the habit of extensive reading.

To draw a conclusion, I firmly believe that reading is beneficial to our personal growth in the long run. Therefore, it is advisable for us to set aside at least half an hour every day for reading and turn it into an enjoyable routine.
argumentation.translation:
如今，随着智能手机日益占据年轻人的闲暇时间，人们对年轻人阅读量下降的担忧与日俱增。

在我看来，养成良好阅读习惯的好处远远大于其成本。首先，阅读开阔我们的视野，让我们足不出户就能了解不同的文化和思想。其次，经常阅读能锻炼我们的思维，提高写作和口语能力。不可否认，博览群书的人更有可能清晰而有说服力地表达自己。一个典型的例子是，大多数优秀学生都将他们出色的成绩归功于广泛阅读的习惯。

总之，我坚信从长远来看，阅读对我们的个人成长是有益的。因此，我们每天留出至少半小时阅读并将其变成愉快的日常习惯是明智的。
argumentation.comment: 四六级议论文标准结构：引入→观点+两点论证+举例→总结建议。高分表达：far outweigh、There is no denying that、A case in point is that、it is advisable for us to。

phenomenon.title: 在线学习日益流行（现象分析）
phenomenon.prompt: Directions: Write an essay on the phenomenon of online learning becoming increasingly popular.
phenomenon.essay:
In recent years, online learning has become increasingly popular among students of all ages, especially after the rapid development of mobile internet.

Several reasons can be identified for this phenomenon. First of all, online courses are highly flexible, allowing learners to study at their own pace anytime and anywhere. Besides, the cost of online education is generally lower than that of traditional training, making it affordable for more people. What is more, the abundant resources on the Internet enable students to choose courses taught by top teachers from all over the country.

This trend exerts a far-reaching influence on education. On the positive side, it promotes the sharing of high-quality educational resources. On the negative side, however, long-time screen use may harm students' eyesight, and some may lack self-discipline without face-to-face supervision. In view of the above, we should take effective measures to strengthen the management of online courses and cultivate students' self-learning ability.
phenomenon.translation:
近年来，在线学习在各个年龄段的学生中越来越受欢迎，尤其是在移动互联网迅速发展之后。

造成这一现象的原因有几个。首先，网络课程非常灵活，学习者可以随时随地按照自己的节奏学习。其次，在线教育的成本通常低于传统培训，更多人能够负担得起。此外，互联网上丰富的资源使学生能够选择全国各地顶尖教师讲授的课程。

这一趋势对教育产生了深远的影响。从积极方面看，它促进了优质教育资源的共享。然而从消极方面看，长时间看屏幕可能损害学生视力，而且没有面对面的监督，有些人可能缺乏自律。鉴于上述情况，我们应该采取有效措施加强网络课程管理，培养学生的自主学习能力。
phenomenon.comment: 现象分析类：引出现象→原因（三点）→影响（正反两面）→对策。高分表达：exert a far-reaching influence on、On the positive side...On the negative side、In view of the above。

cet_letter.title: 给图书馆提建议（建议信）
cet_letter.prompt: Directions: Write a letter to the manager of a library to make some suggestions on improving its service.
cet_letter.essay:
Dear Manager,

I am writing to make some suggestions on improving the service of our library, which I visit almost every week.

To begin with, I suggest extending the opening hours on weekends, since many students prefer to study there on Saturday and Sunday. Moreover, the number of seats is far from enough during the examination period, so it would be helpful to add more study rooms. Finally, I would appreciate it if the library could update its book catalogue and add more latest academic journals in our major fields.

I would be grateful if my suggestions could be taken into serious consideration. I am looking forward to your favorable reply at your earliest convenience.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
cet_letter.translation:
尊敬的馆长：

我写这封信是想就改善我们图书馆的服务提出一些建议，我几乎每周都去那里学习。

首先，我建议延长周末开放时间，因为很多学生喜欢在周六和周日去图书馆学习。其次，考试期间座位远远不够，增加自习室会很有帮助。最后，如果图书馆能够更新图书目录，并增加我们专业领域的最新学术期刊，我将非常感激。

如果我的建议能被认真考虑，我将不胜感激。期待您在方便时尽早给予满意答复。

你真诚的，李明
cet_letter.comment: 建议信结构：写信目的→建议（三点，用 To begin with/Moreover/Finally 衔接）→礼貌结尾。I would appreciate it if... 是礼貌表达建议的高分句式。

cet_chart.title: 大学生选择出国留学人数变化（图表作文）
cet_chart.prompt: Directions: Write an essay based on a chart showing the change in the number of students choosing to study abroad.
cet_chart.essay:
As is clearly shown in the chart, the number of students in our university who choose to study abroad has undergone a steady increase over the past five years, rising from about 300 in 2019 to more than 800 in 2024.

The reasons behind this trend are varied. To begin with, studying abroad provides students with access to world-class educational resources and a multicultural environment, which greatly broadens their horizons. In addition, with the improvement of living standards, more and more families are able to afford the tuition and living expenses abroad. Thanks to the advancement of information technology, students can now learn about foreign universities and apply online with great ease.

To sum up, the trend is expected to continue, which calls for our attention. From my point of view, studying abroad is a valuable experience, but students should also weigh its costs and make rational choices based on their own situations.
cet_chart.translation:
如图所示，我们大学选择出国留学的学生数量在过去五年中稳步增长，从 2019 年的约 300 人上升到 2024 年的 800 多人。

造成这一趋势的原因多种多样。首先，出国留学使学生能够接触世界一流的教育资源和多元文化环境，极大地开阔了他们的视野。其次，随着生活水平的提高，越来越多的家庭能够负担得起国外的学费和生活费。得益于信息技术的发展，学生现在可以非常方便地了解国外大学并在线申请。

总之，这一趋势预计将持续，需要引起我们的关注。在我看来，出国留学是一种宝贵的经历，但学生也应该权衡其成本，并根据自身情况做出理性的选择。
cet_chart.comment: 图表作文：描述数据（有具体数字与增长幅度）→原因分析（三点）→总结+个人观点。rising from...to...、thanks to 等表达准确地道。
